context: M1 o8. After the stick-up at the desk. A resident ran for the police call box on Broadway.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Mr. Arce. Mr. Lefkowitz ran for the call box. In his slippers.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Call box on the corner. Somebody gives a description. A report gets written. Mine.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: He was a trucker out of work, Mrs. Pruitt. He'll sleep it off at Midtown Central.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: And you'll sleep it off behind the glass. Here. The master keys. Manny forgot them.
